title: pvEnSightMasterServerReader
body:
## pvEnSightMasterServerReader

Reads EnSight data written in parallel through a Server-of-Servers master file (.sos) that lists one .case file per partition; the partitions are combined into one multiblock dataset of EnSight parts with the selected node and element variables. Choose it for EnSight output split across processes; for an ordinary .case file use pvEnSightReader. It reads the time given by SetTimeValue and exposes a ByteOrder setting for binary files.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ByteOrder starts as BigEndian; if a binary case loads with nonsensical values, try LittleEndian.
- CaseFileName must be the .sos master file, not one of the .case files it lists.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `EnSightMasterServerReader`. Identity: `sources/ensightMS`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ByteOrder` | This property indicates the byte order of the binary file(s). | `{"type":"enum","values":["BigEndian","LittleEndian"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"BigEndian"` |
| `CaseFileName` | This property specifies the name of the .sos file for the EnSight Master Server reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `SetTimeValue` | This property indicates which time value to read. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvEnSightMasterServerReader",
  "options": {
    "CaseFileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
